# www.qlik.com

> Qlik, now with Talend, delivers a data fabric and next-level insights with its data integration, data quality, & analytics solutions.

## Us

[Qlik Cloud Analytics | Agentic Analytics for Smarter Business Decisions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-data-analytics): Help everyone on your team act with confidence using Qlik Cloud and Agentic AI. Turn trusted data into clear answers and faster decisions.

[Qlik Talend Cloud | Trusted Data Integration for AI and Analytics](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-talend-cloud): Deliver trusted, AI-ready data with real-time integration, built-in quality, and agentic data engineering. Build pipelines faster with AI agents, no-code tools, and 500+ connectors.

[Cloud Reporting Tool & Software for Teams | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-reporting-service): Qlik simplifies reporting: deliver insights to everyone, quickly and easily. Create automated, no-code reports in popular formats like PPT, PDF, and Excel.

[Embedded Analytics Solutions | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-embedded-analytics): Qlik Embedded Analytics Solutions enable you to embed analytics into your applications, providing insights at the point of decision. Learn more now!

[Qlik Cloud Analytics | Agentic Analytics for Smarter Business Decisions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-cloud-analytics): Empower everyone on your team to act with confidence using Qlik Cloud and Agentic AI. Turn trusted data into clear answers and faster decisions.

[No-Code Machine Learning & Data Prediction Software | Qlik Predict](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-predict):  Move beyond historical analysis with Qlik Predict. Empower your analytics teams to forecast trends, uncover drivers, and act on predictive insights.

[Data Visualization and Dashboards | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-visualizations-dashboards): Qlik's data visualization & dashboard solutions help everyone make quick business decisions with intuitive data visualizations & drag-and-drop dashboards.

[Qlik Sense | On-Premise Modern Analytics](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-sense): Discover on-premise analytics with Qlik Sense. Help all users uncover insights and act in real time.

[Cloud Reporting Tool & Software for Teams | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-reporting): Qlik simplifies reporting: deliver insights to everyone, quickly and easily. Create automated, no-code reports in popular formats like PPT, PDF, and Excel.

[Qlik Answers ñ Agentic AI Assistant for Decisions and Productivity](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-answers): Qlik Answers is your Agentic AI assistant for analytics (combining structured and unstructured data to deliver trusted insights with profound context).

[Qlik Cloud Analytics | Agentic Analytics for Smarter Business Decisions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/analytics-products): Empower everyone on your team to act with confidence using Qlik Cloud and Agentic AI. Turn trusted data into clear answers and faster decisions.

[CDC Streaming: Modern Analytics & Data Replication | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-data-streaming-cdc): Qlik's CDC streaming modernizes analytics with real-time data capture. Stream data to various platforms, keep it current, and try it free or request a demo!

[Qlik Replicate: Data Ingestion & Data Replication Solutions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-replicate): Accelerate data replication, ingestion, & data streaming for the widest range of data sources & targets with Qlik Replicate. Explore data replication solutions.

[Cloud Data Transformation Platform | Qlik Talend](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-talend-cloud/data-transformation): Discover Qlik's automated, flexible transformation capabilities, supporting diverse use cases and architectures for streamlined data integration and analytics.

[Data Integration & Quality Solutions | Qlik Intelligent Decisions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-talend-data-integration-and-quality): Drive intelligent decisions with Qlik's data integration and quality solutions. Integrate, transform, and govern high-quality data for sharper insights.

[Data Fabric Platform | Unify, Trust & Govern Data | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/talend-data-fabric): Talend Data Fabric is Qlik's unified solution for data integration, quality, and governance. Connect, transform, and govern all your data in one solution.

[Data Integration & Quality Solutions | Qlik Intelligent Decisions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/data-integration-products): Empower intelligent decisions with Qlik's data integration and quality solutions. Seamlessly integrate, transform, and ensure high-quality data for optimal insights.

[Qlik Talend Cloud | Trusted Data Integration for AI and Analytics](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/cloud-data-integration): Deliver trusted, AI-ready data with real-time integration, built-in quality, and agentic data engineering. Build pipelines faster with AI agents, no-code tools, and 500+ connectors.

[Data Integration & Quality Solutions | Qlik Intelligent Decisions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-data-integration): Empower intelligent decisions with Qlik's data integration and quality solutions. Seamlessly integrate, transform, and ensure high-quality data for optimal insights.

[Data Lake Automation Software | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-compose-data-lakes): Automate data lake design, orchestration, and delivery with Qlikís data lake automation software. Generate pipelines, enforce standards, and publish analytics-ready data faster ó on any cloud.

[Data Movement Platform: Fast, No-Code, Enterprise-Grade Data Delivery | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/data-movement): Qlikís data movement solution automates enterprise-grade replication to accelerate data delivery across data lakes, data warehouses, and cloud architectures (securely and with no-code control).

[Qlik Enterprise Manager ñ Data Ingestion Management | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-enterprise-manager): Qlik Enterprise Manager is your command center to configure, execute, and monitor replication and transformation tasks across the enterprise. Learn more

[Data Preparation Platform for Analytics, AI, and ML | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-data-preparation): Qlik's data preparation helps you visually prepare, transform, and clean data for analytics, ML, and AI with no-code, drag-and-drop tools.

[Data Warehouse Automation | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/data-warehouse-automation): Dramatically reduce the time, costs, and risks of data warehousing projects with agile data warehouse automation solutions from Qlik. Contact us today!

[Data Catalog Solutions | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-catalog): Qlik Talend Data Catalog solutions enable you to deliver trusted data across your organization. Solve your data challenges with us, try it for FREE!

[Agile Data Warehouse Software & Automation | Qlik Compose](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-compose-data-warehouses): Qlik Compose for data warehouses automates & streamlines data warehouse creation & operation, reducing time, cost, and risk for BI projects. Request a demo today!

[Talend Data Quality and Governance Platform | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/data-quality-governance): Qlik Talend offers a unified approach to data quality and governance for modernizing your cloud data infrastructure. Request a demo today!

[Qlik Discovery Agent | AI-Powered Data Change Detection](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/discovery-agent): Stay ahead of data shifts with Qlik Discovery Agent. Detect anomalies and trend changes automatically ó before they impact decisions.

[Qlik Data Catalog & Lineage Software for Analytics](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/catalog-and-lineage): Qlikís catalog and lineage capabilities make it easy for anyone on your team to find, understand & use trusted data.

[Qlik MCP Server | Access Trusted Intelligence for AI Reasoning](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/model-context-protocol): Qlik MCP server connects AI to trusted data and high-performance analytics, enabling accurate reasoning, automation, and confident business decisions.

[Data Foundation for AI | Real-Time Data for AI Agents | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/data-foundation-ai): Deliver AI-ready data in real-time with agentic data engineering, integrated quality, governance, and the Qlik Trust Score. Build trusted data products for ML, RAG, and autonomous AI workflows.

[Data Products: Streamline Data Management | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/data-products): Qlikís Data Products enables a unique product-centric approach to streamlining data management.

[Enterprise API Integration Solution & Tools | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/application-api-integration): Streamline workflows with Qlik's API integration solution. Connect SaaS apps, automate DevOps, and design microservices with our low-code integration tools.

[SAP Test Data Management Platform | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-gold-client): Streamline SAP test data management and SAP modernization while improving data availability and quality in SAP environments with Qlik Gold Client (Attunity).

[SAP Data Integration and Analytics Solutions | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/technology/sap): Get the most from SAP data with Qlik, enable real-time SAP data integration, world-class SAP analytics & reliable SAP testing and migration.

[Data Products: Streamline Data Management | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/data-products-catalog): Qlikís Data Products enables a unique product-centric approach to streamlining data management.

[Qlik Automate: No Code Workflow Automation for Enterprise](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-automate): Automate workflows and analytics with Qlikís no-code enterprise automation. From data to decision ó instantly.

[Qlik Automate: No Code Workflow Automation for Enterprise](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/application-automation): Automate workflows and analytics with Qlikís no-code enterprise automation platform. From data to decision; instantly.

[SAP Data Protection & Privacy Software | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-gold-client-for-data-protection): Ensure SAP data protection and compliance with Qlik Gold Client. Automate data masking, secure PII in test environments, and handle GDPR/CCPA requests efficiently.

[SAP Test Data Management Platform | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/technology/sap/sap-test-data-management): Streamline SAP test data management and SAP modernization while improving data availability and quality in SAP environments with Qlik Gold Client (Attunity).

[Qlik Open Lakehouse | Data Lakehouse Platform | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-open-lakehouse): Build, tune, and scale your data lakehouse with Qlik Open Lakehouse. Use Apache Iceberg, open formats, and AI-tuned performance for modern analytics.

[Qlik Cloud Analytics | Agentic Analytics for Smarter Business Decisions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/associative-engine): Empower everyone on your team to act with confidence using Qlik Cloud and Agentic AI. Turn trusted data into clear answers and faster decisions.

[Why choose Qlik?](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-cloud): Find out why 50,000+ customers turn to Qlik for Active Intelligence through our comprehensive data integration & analytics cloud.

[Qlik Cloud Analytics | Agentic Analytics for Smarter Business Decisions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/associative-difference): Empower everyone on your team to act with confidence using Qlik Cloud and Agentic AI. Turn trusted data into clear answers and faster decisions.

[Qlik Cloud Analytics | Agentic Analytics for Smarter Business Decisions](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-sense/mobile-analytics): Empower everyone on your team to act with confidence using Qlik Cloud and Agentic AI. Turn trusted data into clear answers and faster decisions.

[Cloud Reporting Tool & Software for Teams | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-sense/data-alerts): Qlik simplifies reporting: deliver insights to everyone, quickly and easily. Create automated, no-code reports in popular formats like PPT, PDF, and Excel.

[Data Visualization and Dashboards | Qlik](https://www.qlik.com/us/products/qlik-sense/geospatial-analysis): Qlik's data visualization & dashboard solutions empower everyone to make quick business decisions with intuitive data visualizations & drag-and-drop dashboards.
